pages.text: start with a nearby dungeon. bring a shield, watch the spawners, and leave yourself a clear route out.$(br2)lootr chests give each player their own loot. if you're exploring with friends, everyone opens everything - nobody can ninja your roll.
watch for apotheosis gear with extra modifiers, and read what those modifiers do. head home when you've found something worth keeping. the dungeon will still be there.
